title: Jurisdiction
relevance: Primary official source for UCPD Berkeley's campus-and-associated-properties jurisdiction, Berkeley PD's off-campus role, and the four specific cooperative properties where UCPD has primary responsibility.

title: Enhancing Safety On Campus and In the Community
relevance: Official Berkeley statement that UCPD is responsible for the main campus and university properties while Berkeley Police handles city property bordering campus and adjacent neighborhoods.
notes: Useful for distinguishing campus-owned geography from adjacent city-policing geography.

title: 2022 VCA Annual Report - UC Police Department Berkeley
relevance: Official Berkeley source stating that UCPD Berkeley has primary law-enforcement jurisdiction on the Berkeley campus and associated university properties in Albany, Berkeley, Emeryville, Kensington, Oakland, and Richmond.
notes: Core source showing the footprint spans multiple cities and crosses the Berkeley city boundary.

title: Campus Map
relevance: Official map page describing the Berkeley Campus as Campus Park, Hill Campus, Clark Kerr Campus, and other university-owned properties, while warning that some off-campus locations are not shown on campus maps.
notes: Important for separating the core campus map from the full property footprint.

title: Printable Campus Map (PDF)
relevance: Official printable campus map for the main Berkeley campus footprint.
notes: Useful for the core campus geometry component but not sufficient for the entire UCPD footprint.

title: Family Student Housing: University Village
relevance: Official Berkeley housing source identifying University Village as family student housing in Albany.
notes: Confirms a named non-Berkeley UC Berkeley property within the UCPD-served footprint.

title: Home
relevance: Official Richmond Field Station site describing it as UC Berkeley's campus for applied research across 175 acres.
notes: Confirms a named Richmond UC Berkeley property within the UCPD-served footprint.

title: Education Code Section 92600
relevance: Primary California statute defining UC police authority on campuses, within one mile of campus boundaries, and on Regents-controlled property.
notes: Legal baseline for scope analysis; important for distinguishing legal authority from operational footprint.

title: Penal Code Section 830.2
relevance: Primary California statute granting UC police statewide peace-officer status while tying primary duty back to Education Code Section 92600 geography.
notes: Legal corroboration that statewide authority does not make this a statewide UC-system footprint.

title: History of Richmond
relevance: Official Richmond page stating Richmond is located on the western shore of Contra Costa County.
notes: Used to verify that the Berkeley-named Richmond property lies outside Alameda County.

title: Kensington
relevance: Official Contra Costa County page treating Kensington as a county-governed community.
notes: Used to verify that the Berkeley-named Kensington property is not inside an Alameda County proxy.
